svg.aria-label: notwafel - Backend Developer. Hey, I'm notwafel - mostly a backend guy and a bit of a tech fanatic. I'm always testing some random project, hunting for bugs, analyzing them, fixing what I find and committing the result. Git, GitHub and Docker are my daily bread, and I only touch frontend when I really have to. There's always some course going on in the background too. Tech stack: JavaScript, Rust, Swift, Node.js, MongoDB, MySQL, MariaDB, Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux, Nginx, HTML5, CSS3.
